strategies.name: Detection of Replication Through Removable Media

analytics.name: Analytic 1802
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Replication Through Removable Media by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: File with binary signature (.apk, .dex, .so, .sh) written to app storage or /data/local/tmp/ from USB-mounted path or external storage within $USBInstallWindow$]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [Application installed with install_source=adb or install_source=sideload from USB-connected host within $USBInstallWindow$ of USB mode change]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 300s between USB mode change and install or file delivery event. Tightening: 60s — synchronous USB delivery.
Device serial numbers authorized for developer mode (test/dev fleet only). Derive from IT device management. Production devices should have empty list.

analytics.name: Analytic 1803
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Replication Through Removable Media from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Host Status via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]; Protected Configuration via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]; System Settings via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
